name: Martyr’s Countenance
body:
The sight of your stigmata is inspiring for the members of your faith and terrifying for your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Stigmata class feature.

Benefit(s): When your stigmata are active, you gain a bonus equal to your holy vindicator class level on Diplomacy skill checks with members of your faith, and on Intimidate skill checks with members of faiths opposite to yours on the chaos/law or evil/good axis.
